techStack: React 19, TypeScript ~5.7, Vite 6, Vitest 3 with jsdom environment
TypeScript strict flags: noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters — underscore-prefixed names (_onChange) are the current workaround for unused props
verbatimModuleSyntax enabled — all imports must be value imports or explicitly `import type`
Build: tsc -b && vite build — type errors will fail the build; pnpm test runs vitest run
Vitest globals enabled — no imports of describe/it/expect needed in test files
Coverage scoped to src/utils/productFilters.ts — that file is under direct test scrutiny
features: filterProducts.ts: function signature and FilterState type are correct; all filter/sort logic is TODO stubs — nothing currently filters or sorts
FilterPanel.tsx: all 4 event handlers (search input, category select, inStockOnly checkbox, Clear Filters button) are () => {} no-ops; onChange prop is destructured as _onChange
SortSelect.tsx: onChange handler on the select element is () => {} no-op; onChange prop is destructured as _onChange
App.tsx: passes setFilters directly to FilterPanel (missing setPage(1)); passes inline spread-lambda to SortSelect (missing setPage(1))
useProductFilters.ts: fully functional — provides filters, setFilters, page, setPage, totalPages, products, isLoading, error; must not be modified
types/product.ts: complete Product interface — id, name, category, price, inStock, rating, reviewCount, description, tags, optional discountPct
architecture: Component tree: App → FilterPanel, SortSelect, Spinner, ProductList → ProductCard, Pagination controls
All state lives in App via useProductFilters(); visibleProducts and categories are useMemo-derived
FilterState type: { search: string; category: string; inStockOnly: boolean; sortBy: 'default' | 'price-asc' | 'price-desc' | 'rating-desc' }
FilterPanel onChange prop type: (next: FilterState) => void — receives entire new FilterState object
SortSelect onChange prop type: (sortBy: FilterState['sortBy']) => void — receives only the sort value string
filterProducts belongs in src/utils/productFilters.ts as a pure function (no side effects, no mutation)
Event handler wiring belongs inside FilterPanel.tsx and SortSelect.tsx component bodies
App.tsx wrapper functions must call both setFilters(newState) and setPage(1)
edgeCases: Search: must trim whitespace before comparing; whitespace-only input ('   ') must match all products (trim → '' → no filter)
Search: case-insensitive — 'MOUSE' must match 'Wireless Mouse'; use .toLowerCase() on both sides
Category 'All': must pass every product through regardless of product.category value
inStockOnly false: all products pass; only when true filter to product.inStock === true
Sort must run AFTER all filters — sort the already-filtered array, not the raw input
Must not mutate input: use [...products] spread before .sort() so original API-response order is preserved
sortBy 'default': no reorder — return filtered array in its original order (do not sort at all)
Clear Filters must pass exactly { search: '', category: 'All', inStockOnly: false, sortBy: 'default' } — all four fields reset together
setPage(1) must be called on BOTH FilterPanel onChange and SortSelect onChange in App.tsx — not just one
TypeScript: _onChange must be renamed to onChange inside components to satisfy noUnusedLocals; or the destructured name changed to call it
Exact out-of-stock products: USB-C Hub, Noise-Cancelling Headphones, Dumbbell Set, Desk Lamp — inStockOnly must exclude exactly these 4 (leaving 11)
Exact price-asc order starts with Jump Rope (cheapest) and ends with Noise-Cancelling Headphones (most expensive)
rating-desc: Yoga Mat (4.8) first, Mechanical Keyboard (4.7) second — no ties at top
